mapper.select: SELECT s.skill_id,s.publisher_id,p.user_id AS owner_user_id,r.name FROM t_skill s JOIN t_skill_publisher p ON p.publisher_id=s.publisher_id LEFT JOIN t_skill_revision r ON r.revision_id=s.public_revision_id AND r.skill_id=s.skill_id WHERE s.skill_id=#{skillId}
SELECT publisher_id,user_id,status FROM t_skill_publisher WHERE publisher_id=#{id} FOR SHARE
SELECT skill_id,publisher_id,status,current_version_id,public_revision_id FROM t_skill WHERE skill_id=#{id} FOR SHARE
SELECT version_id,skill_id,artifact_id,status FROM t_skill_version WHERE version_id=#{id} FOR SHARE
SELECT artifact_id,owner_user_id,status FROM t_skill_artifact WHERE artifact_id=#{id} FOR SHARE
